mainEntity.name: Can I rent out my garage conversion ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, in most cases, you can rent out your garage conversion ADU. California state laws generally support the creation of ADUs to address housing shortages and often prohibit local governments from imposing owner-occupancy requirements. This makes ADUs an excellent option for generating rental income. However, local ordinances may still have specific regulations regarding short-term vs. long-term rentals.
